Post to X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, and 10 more platforms with a single command

Excited to announce the launch of iHatePosting CLI! 🎉

As developers, we know how time-consuming social media management can be. That's why we built a powerful CLI tool that makes scheduling posts across 15 platforms effortless.

Key features:
• Multi-platform support (X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, and more)
• Thread and carousel creation
• Scheduled posting with precise timing
• Provider-specific settings and customization
• Built for AI agents and automation

Whether you're managing a personal brand, running marketing campaigns, or building AI-powered social media tools, iHatePosting CLI has you covered.

Check it out and let us know your thoughts!
